Product Overview

This listing features a high-performance halophile-culture brine tun, meticulously engineered to deliver superior results in industrial and research settings. With a substantial vessel volume of 383 litres, it is designed to accommodate extensive batch processes, ensuring robust and consistent output.

Key Specifications

  • Working Temperature: Optimally maintained at 23°C, this tun guarantees the ideal conditions for halophile cultures, maximizing efficiency and yield.
  • Batch Cycle: The impressive batch cycle of 169 days underscores the tun's suitability for long-term operations, reducing downtime and increasing productivity.
  • Simultaneous Capacity: Engineered to handle 10 batches concurrently, it significantly enhances throughput, setting a new benchmark for scalability in its category.
  • Atmosphere Control: The vessel operates within a sealed, pressurized environment, ensuring precise atmosphere control for the most demanding applications and safeguarding culture integrity.
  • Pricing: The unit price is competitively set post-acceptance, reflecting the tun’s premium quality and performance.
